ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:1 ratio between high-intensity peripheral regions and low-intensity central region; extreme bimodal distribution with sharp transitions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) central region extending from the peduncle attachment to the mid-lobes. High-intensity (white) regions occupy the outer lateral portions of both lobes. Distinct black mottling and islands are present within the white regions along the distal trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. The right lobe tip exhibits high-amplitude jagged irregularities compared to the relatively smoother left lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex trailing edges sweeping upwards to acute-angled lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several high-intensity (white) circular clusters detected within the central black pigmentation, most notably a pair of distinct spots in the upper-right quadrant of the black region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear marks. One prominent diagonal white line on the left-central black field and a cluster of horizontal/diagonal rake marks on the right-central black field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular truncation and jagged contouring on the distal end of the right lobe; extensive linear scarring across the central pigmentation field.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated white pixel cluster (island) located within the black region immediately to the right of the median notch.
